messages.content:
需求：前后端：将 title 上限由 80 调整为 120，下限仍为 3；description 的非空值上限由 255 调整为 500，不修剪 description。

持续有效约束：title 的修剪、必填与 null 规则不变；description 缺省和 null 语义不变。title 长度 120 成功、121 失败；description 长度 500 成功、501 失败。

本次变更事实：
[FACT:request-title-max-length] request.title.max_length = 120
[FACT:request-description-max-length] request.description.max_length = 500
[FACT:request-description-trim] request.description.trim = false

当前契约事实：
[FACT:request-title-trim] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.trim = "U+0020"
[FACT:request-title-length-unit] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.length_unit = "unicode_code_point"
[FACT:request-title-min-length] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.min_length = 3
[FACT:request-title-max-length] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.max_length = 120
[FACT:create-title-required] (frontend,backend; derivable) create.title.required = true
[FACT:update-title-required] (frontend,backend; derivable) update.title.required = false
[FACT:request-title-nullable] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.nullable = false
[FACT:request-title-invalid-status] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.invalid_status = 422
[FACT:update-title-omission] (frontend,backend; derivable) update.title.omission = "unchanged"
[FACT:request-description-max-length] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.description.max_length = 500
[FACT:request-description-trim] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.description.trim = false
